career_ladder.note: Engineers and Officers in Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) are appointed in Salary Scale E2 (₹50,000–₹1,60,000) and undergo 1 year of probation. Promotion through executive management grades is based on annual Performance Management System (PMS) ratings, minimum qualifying residency periods, and Departmental Promotion Committees (DPC).

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT), Group Task (GT), and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is compiled by assigning 85% weightage to CBT, 5% weightage to Group Task, and 10% weightage to Personal Interview. There is no negative marking in the CBT.

financial_package.note: Engineers and Officers in HPCL enter in Salary Scale E2 (₹50,000–₹1,60,000) with starting basic pay of ₹50,000, 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances up to 35%, and company quarters or HRA. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹17.33 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_source_label: HPCL Recruitment Notification Emoluments Table (CTC Approx Rs 17.33 Lakh for 50000-160000 scale)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹50,000 with 58% IDA (₹29,000), Perks under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of Basic Pay (₹17,500), House Rent Allowance (9% to 27% = ₹4,500 to ₹13,500 depending on posting location in Mumbai/Visakhapatnam refineries or regional marketing offices), less statutory Provident Fund (12% of Basic+DA = ₹9,480) and tax deductions. Annual CTC is approx ₹17.33 Lakhs.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly as per AICPI
Perquisites and allowances under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of Basic Pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) linked to corporation profitability and individual MoU ratings
Company Leased Accommodation / Quarters in refinery townships or HRA in lieu thereof
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Defined Contributory Superannuation Pension Scheme
Comprehensive medical facilities for self and dependent family members under HPCL Medical Scheme
